newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - Evening Standard - April 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Evening Standard - April 16.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
- HERE COME THE JUDGE, MR CLARK

Alan Clark is to face opposition in his constituency of the London Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. The judge whose wife and daughters had affairs with Tory minister is returning from South Africa to warn constituents against his 'dishonesty'.
- PERKY POUND TAKES IT A LITTLE EASIER

In overnight markets sterling fell back slightly following yesterday's high not seen since Britain dropped out of the exchange rate mechanism in 1992. A sharp increase in US stocks led to further rallies in share markets.

Industries is involved with breakthrough talks in the US which propose that in return for previously unthinkable concessions there would be a limit on the exposure of tobacco giants to litigating smokers.
- RESORT HOTELS LOSERS CHECK LEGAL OPTIONS
A meeting is being held this week by Resort Hotels bankrupt shareholders to decide whether to take legal action against company auditors Coopers and Lybrand.
- DOW JONES BERATED OVER TELERATE DRAIN

The Dow Jones market data service Telerate is the subject of dissatisfaction amongst Dow Jones shareholders. The shareholders are expected to meet today to confront management with their decision to invest 650mn US Dollars or 400mn stg into the troubled service.
